name: Create detailed day-by-day travel itineraries
description: Users requested the creation of detailed, day-by-day travel itineraries for specific destinations, durations, and budgets, often including logistical details such as transportation schedules, accommodation recommendations, and activity timing. Some requests involved optimizing routes for efficiency or evaluating existing plans, with variations ranging from short city breaks to multi-week road trips and long-haul tours.
